question: Explain standard costing. State its advantages and limitations.
sources: Standard costing: setting standards and variance analysis

points.label: Meaning
points.description: Standard costing sets pre-determined costs for each element of cost and compares them with actual costs to find variances.

points.label: Variance analysis
points.description: Variances are analysed into their causes and responsibility is fixed so that corrective action can be taken.

points.label: Advantages for control
points.description: It allows management by exception, makes people cost conscious and helps measure efficiency.

points.label: Other advantages
points.description: It helps in fixing prices, valuing inventory, preparing budgets and simplifies record-keeping.

points.label: Limitations
points.description: Setting correct standards is hard and costly, standards become out of date when conditions change, and it may not suit firms making non-standard products.
